name: kanban-musume-vscode
description: Anime characters living in your editor: a mascot that walks along VS Code's edge over a faded illustration, reacts to your typing and clicks, takes turns with the others, and acts out your coding agent's work.

commands.title: 餵任務給寵物 (Give the pet a task)
取消目前任務 (Cancel the task)
把角色放進編輯器 (Put the character in the editor)
把角色從編輯器移除 (Remove the character from the editor)

acpPet.characters.description: Characters that take turns, in order. Picture skins: bundled deepseek, flandre, remilia, and folders in ~/.acp-pet/skins (such as hikari-art, nozomi-art). Ones that aren't installed are skipped.

acpPet.rotateMinutes.description: Switch to the next character every N minutes. 0 keeps the current one.

acpPet.agent.description: acpx agent that runs tasks you give the pet (claude, codex, gemini…). It must already be installed and logged in.

acpPet.reactToEditor.description: Act out your own editing too: typing, saving, errors, tasks and debugging.

acpPet.permissionTimeoutSec.description: Seconds before an unanswered permission sign counts as Deny.

acpPet.editor.backgroundOpacity.description: How strongly the character's background illustration (~/.acp-pet/backgrounds/<id>.png) shows over the editor. 0 hides it.

acpPet.editor.height.description: Height of the character in the editor, in pixels.
